title: CF Meet cross-service durable event envelope v1
description: Infrastructure envelope for durable cross-service events. Producers persist events transactionally (outbox) with the state change they describe. The payload is described by its own registered contract identified by event_type and schema_version; no payload contracts exist yet. The envelope never carries secrets, service tokens, customer credentials, provider credentials, telephone numbers or protected contact plaintext.

event_type.description: Dot-separated event type, prefixed by the producing domain.

schema_version.description: Major version of the payload contract.

causation_id.description: event_id of the event that caused this one, if any.

ownership.description: Owning customer scope of the event subject, when the subject belongs to a tenant.

payload.description: Event payload (validated against its own contract). Top-level keys are snake_case; keys that name secrets or contact data are refused.
